- Registered office (legal): 412 Harborview Drive, Suite 200, Port Everett, WA 98109
- Primary bank (for payments): Cascade Federal Bank, Account ending 3124 (ABA: 121000038)

Sofia — thanks for the heads-up and the attachments. I’ve uploaded the docs to the vendor portal and started an internal ticket to update Northcliff’s vendor record. Two quick asks to keep the change clean from our side:

1) Can you confirm an authorization contact (name + phone) we can add to the vendor profile for one-touch verification?
2) For payments, we require a signed bank-change authorization with the vendor's letterhead and a scanned voided check or bank letter. I see bank_change_authorization_signed.pdf attached — that looks good, but could you also attach a voided check or bank letter as supporting evidence?

We’ll target the cutover on Monday, Feb 15, assuming we receive the supporting bank evidence by end of day Thursday (Feb 11). Laura — can you flag this for AP so the routing is updated for PO #84751 and any future invoices? Karthik — can you confirm if procurement needs to re-run any PO approvals given the legal address change?

Sofia — I’ll reply here once AP schedules the change and we’ll include DocuSign confirmation if needed.

Best,

Laura / Karthik / Sofia — quick update from our side.

- Laura: AP has scheduled the vendor record update for Feb 15 EOD. I’ve added the new registered office to the vendor profile and attached an internal memo summarizing the change (vendor_record_update_memo.pdf). AP will change remittance routing for new invoices to Cascade Federal (Acct ending 3124) and update the remit-to address to the new legal address. Please confirm when the change is live in the ERP.
- Karthik: Procurement does not need to re-approve existing POs for this seller — no change to seller terms or tax classification. We’ll keep PO #84751 as-is, but routing will point to the new remittance account effective Feb 15. If you want me to add a note to the PO, I can do that.
- Sofia: we’ll treat Feb 15 as the payment cutover date. Please send the Feb 15 invoice to ap@redwood.com as usual and I’ll follow up once AP processes the first remittance.

Next steps: AP confirms ERP change (Laura), we notify Northcliff via this thread when remittance is switched (Marissa), Northcliff confirms first payment arrived in new account (Sofia).

Thanks all — let’s close out once AP confirms.

Best,
Marissa
